| colspan="100%" align="left" style=width:50px;| '''Notes:'''
{{refbegin}}{{note|tribecaptain|1}} As the winner of the first Reward Challenge, Clarisse became the first tribe captain. She then chose Paul as the opposite tribe captain and both drew their tribe via a schoolyard pick.<br />{{note|duel|2}} After he was voted out, Lionel earned the right to challenge one of his tribemates in a duel. He challenged Françoise who lost the duel. He thus earned the right to stay in the game and won himself an Immunity Necklace. Françoise was eliminated in his place.<br />{{note|necklace|3}} Lionel played an Immunity Necklace, negating all votes against him.<br />{{note|potterynecklace|4}} After she was voted out, Karine earned the right to grant an Immunity Necklace to one of her tribemates. She chose Cindy.<br />{{note|necklace2|5}} Cindy played an Immunity Necklace, negating all votes against her.<br />{{note|switch|6}} Jonathan was unanimously voted out but in the Lair of Destinies, he chose a pottery that contains a second shot at the game. He thus stayed in the game and switched tribe.<br />{{note|ambassadors|7}} At the ambassadors meeting, the four ambassadors agreed to vote Jonathan out of the game.<br />{{note|tie|8}} The vote resulted in a tie. Per ''Koh-Lanta'' rules, a revote would commence.<br />{{note|deadlock|9}} A deadlock tie occurred, thus forcing the tied castaways to draw rocks.<br />{{note|potterynecklace2|10}} After he was voted out, Ulrich earned the right to grant an Immunity Necklace to one of his tribemates. He chose Jade.<br />{{note|necklace3|11}} Jade played an Immunity Necklace on Hugo, negating all votes against him.<br />{{note|final12|12}} Paul came in last in the Immunity Challenge and was directly eliminated from the game.<br />{{note|comeback|13}} After they were voted out, Jade and Lola earned the right to come back into the game while challenging one of their tribemates and the last person sent to Jury, Guillaume. The first two castaways to finish the challenge would reenter the game while the other two would be permanently eliminated. They chose to challenge Zakariya and they both failed the challenge. As the first castaway to finish the challenge, Guillaume came back in the game with an Immunity Necklace.<br />{{note|tieddestinies|14}}  Jade was Lola's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore she was also eliminated when Lola was voted out.<br />{{note|necklace4|15}} Cynthia and Guillaume both played an Immunity Necklace. Cynthia negated all votes against her while there was no votes against Guillaume.<br />{{note|duel2|16}} After he was voted out, Hugo earned the right to challenge one of his tribemates in a duel. He challenged Cindy who lost the duel. He thus earned the right to stay in the game and won himself an Immunity Necklace. Cindy was eliminated in his place.<br />{{note|necklace5|17}} Cynthia and Hugo both played an Immunity Necklace, both negating all votes against them.<br />{{note|voteremoval|18}} After he was voted out, Antonin earned the right to prevent one of his tribemates to vote at the next Tribal Council. He chose Guillaume.<br />{{note|duel3|19}} After he was voted out, Guillaume earned the right to challenge one of his tribemates in a duel. He challenged Daniel who lost the duel. He thus earned the right to stay in the game. Daniel was eliminated in his place.<br />{{note|final5|20}} At the final five, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Caroline and Hugo came in last and were eliminated.<br />{{refend}}
